messages:
Elaine (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — SecretWeave confirmed the joint-launch cadence. They want a marketplace listing + coordinated announcement on June 12. We need sync on SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and BYO-KMS/HSM compatibility. Short timeline: docs + integration tests + press blurb.

Mike (Security): Thanks. Can we get their SAML metadata endpoint and an HSM compatibility matrix from them? Also need our threat model/attack surface note for BYO-KMS.

Anas (Eng): I can own the BYO-KMS integration tests. Requesting sample PKCS#11 / gRPC endpoints (or dummy HSM) and an expected key rotation window. Also need SCIM user provisioning flows (bulk create/update).

Sofia (Docs): I will draft the partner guide and step-by-step how-to for: SAML SP setup, SCIM mappings, and BYO-KMS onboarding. Can someone drop sample metadata + SCIM test accounts here?

Elaine (Partnerships): @Mike we'll need security sign-off list and any gating items. @Anas can you confirm required test vectors? I'll ask SecretWeave for the metadata and sample SCIM tenant by EOD.

Anas (Eng): Test vectors I need: 1) SAML login flow with signed assertions, 2) SCIM create/update/delete for 10k users, 3) BYO-KMS sign/verify + key rotate. Quick curl to fetch metadata for tests:
```bash
curl -sS https://secretweave.example.com/saml/metadata.xml -o metadata.xml
```
If they don't have a real HSM we can run PKCS#11 emulator (SoftHSM) for CI.

Mike (Security): For BYO-KMS we must validate: key wrapping, access scoping, audit events, and offline rotation workflow. I'll produce a short checklist.

deploy-bot: Release window reserved: 2026-06-12 18:00 UTC. Please confirm the cutover plan and rollback playbooks.

Ralph (Sales): I'll coordinate the embargoed press and partner quotes. Do we have customer references they can quote? If not, we should keep messaging generic.

Sofia (Docs): Draft plan: create PR in docs repo with: overview, quickstart, SCIM mapping table, SAML troubleshooting, BYO-KMS sample config, and a security checklist link. Target: PR by Friday COB.

Mike (Security): I'll review the security checklist Tue morning. If we find high-risk items we gate the marketplace listing until mitigations are in place.

Anas (Eng): I'll add CI jobs for: saml_smoke, scim_load_10k, kms_emulator_rotate. ETA: feature branch by Wed. Will ping when ready.

Elaine (Partnerships): Owner roundup: Docs = Sofia, Security sign-off = Mike, Eng integration/tests = Anas, Sales/PR = Ralph. I'll own partner coordination + meeting facilitation.

Ralph (Sales): Noted. I'll draft the partner blurb and send to Elaine for review.

Sofia (Docs): Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 — still WIP, but includes SCIM mapping table and example SAML metadata notes.

Mike (Security): Reviewing PR now. Small nit: call out 1) assertion expiry tolerance, 2) clock skew policy, 3) mandatory assertion signing.

Anas (Eng): CI jobs green in my branch. Need someone to run end-to-end with their test tenant. Elaine, can you coordinate test access?

Elaine (Partnerships): I have their test tenant creds coming tonight. Scheduling a 30m launch rehearsal Thurs 16:00 PT — please RSVP. Agenda: run SAML login, push SCIM changes, BYO-KMS rotate, and failover to our hosted key if BYO fails.

Ralph (Sales): RSVP from me. Will also rehearse the PR talking points.

Sofia (Docs): RSVP. I'll bring the docs checklist and open the troubleshooting doc.

Mike (Security): RSVP. I'll bring the sign-off checklist and rollback criteria.

Anas (Eng): RSVP. I'll run the CI and monitor logs, + attach the PKCS#11 emulator if needed.

Elaine (Partnerships): Great — thanks everyone. We'll capture notes in the partner confluence: https://rw-confluence.company/partners/secretweave (I'll update after rehearsal). :thumbsup:
